title: Hybrid Mechanical and Agentic Specification Inference
abstract: arXiv:2605.10005v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Adoption of formal verification has long been hindered by the cost of manual specification. To prove high-level properties, one must also write contracts for supporting functions, many of which are mechanical and low-level. Specification inference automatically derives such contracts from the program. We present a hybrid of mechanical and agentic inference for Move, a smart contract language, integrated into its verifier, the Move Prover. A large language model (LLM) agent drives inference and verification through a tool that calls the Move Prover and derives specifications from code by weakest-precondition (WP) analysis. We evaluate our approach on 26 targets, 24 of them extracted from public Move functions of the Aptos framework that have no specifications, under a frontier model and a mid-tier model of the same family (Sol 5.6 and Terra 5.6). translated_title: 机械式与智能体式混合的规约推断
translated_abstract: 形式化验证的采用长期以来一直受到人工编写规约成本的阻碍。为了证明高层属性，人们还必须为辅助函数编写契约，而其中许多是机械性的且处于低层次。规约推断可以从程序中自动推导出此类契约。我们针对智能合约语言 Move 提出了一种将机械式推断与智能体式推断相结合的混合方法，并将其集成到其验证器 Move Prover 中。一个大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过一个调用 Move Prover 的工具来驱动推断与验证，并通过最弱前置条件（WP）分析从代码中推导规约。我们在 26 个目标上评估了该方法，其中 24 个提取自 Aptos 框架中没有规约的公开 Move 函数，测试使用了同一模型家族的前沿模型与中端模型（Sol 5.6 和 Terra 5.6）。无论是否使用 WP 分析，智能体都完成了超过 90% 的运行任务，因此智能体式推断……
tldr: 该论文将机械式最弱前置条件（WP）分析与LLM智能体驱动的规约推断相结合，集成到 Move Prover 中自动为 Move 智能合约推导规约，在 Aptos 框架的无规约公开函数上实现了超过 90% 的任务完成率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid approach combining mechanical weakest-precondition (WP) analysis with LLM agent-driven specification inference, integrated into the Move Prover to automatically derive specifications for Move smart contracts, achieving over 90% completion on unspecified public Aptos framework functions.
